Why Me

Most consultants are one thing. I've been all three.

The engineer who evaluates the product, the seller who wins the contract, and the builder who runs the business.

I'm a mechatronics engineer with 18+ years and a $300M+ portfolio across government, defense and industry — 1,200+ clients, 200+ vendors relationship-managed. Because I evaluate products and engineer best-value solutions, I work without product or solution limits: SaaS, IT, industrial equipment, anything.

I've sat on every side of the table. I built three businesses from the ground up, ran my own manufacturing facility, qualified the suppliers, and sold to the DoD, DoW, NATO and Canadian federal buyers. Defense procurement — NSN, DLA, PSPC/DND — is my specialty.

When a procurement goes wrong, I fight it: two Canadian bid protests before the CITT, one won, the legal responses written by me — because clients shouldn't lose a dollar they've earned.

I build the tools too: two AI-powered SaaS products delivered under NDA, plus agentic-AI workflows that let me deliver in days what takes others weeks. And I back it with a guarantee — every solution vetted with the OEMs and SMEs first.
